headline: Gold jumps to a new high in our 11-day history; silver rebounds after a dip
summary: Today's change is a sharp rise: 24K gold is up ₹322 per gram (2.25%) from yesterday to ₹14,602, and 22K is up ₹295 to ₹13,385. Silver rose ₹10,000 per kg (5%) to ₹2,10,000. Over the last 7 days gold is up about 1.44% and silver is down 2.33%, and across the full 11-day history silver is down 4.55% from its high of ₹2,20,000 on 26 October. Possible drivers include movements in international prices and the US dollar against the rupee, with spot gold and silver currently slightly lower than today's domestic rates.
outlook: If you are buying jewellery or coins this week, compare the making charges and GST across shops, since today's sharp one-day rise may ease or reverse, and there is no need to rush.
